facts.text: Palmersville was founded in 1842 on land owned by Smith Palmer, after whom the town is named.
The settlement grew around a grist and saw mill, general stores, a church, and fraternal societies, reflecting early agricultural roots.
In 1891, Minida Normal College opened in Palmersville, offering a B.A. degree and marking the town’s first higher‑education institution.
Palmersville’s early 20th‑century economy included a cheese factory, flour and sawmills, a drug store, bank, telephone switchboard, and blacksmith shop, showing diverse small‑scale industry.
Palmersville sits at the crossroads of state routes 89 and 190, a fact that helped it become a foundational settlement in Weakley County.
